subject: Enterprise RFP: audit log export runbook + answers
messages:
From: Alice Ng <security-review@bigbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bigbank.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP Q: Audit logs, retention & exportability

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this RFP. A few specific questions came up in our compliance review related to audit trails and log exportability. Could you confirm the following for Redwood's hosted offering?

1) What audit events are retained by default and for how long (auth events, model invocation metadata, admin changes, key rotations, policy changes)?
2) Can we request bulk exports of audit logs and full request/response traces? If so, what formats and delivery methods do you support (S3 presigned upload, HTTPS push, JSONL/Parquet, etc.)?
3) What is the SLA for producing a one-off export for legal/forensic requests (hours/days)?
4) Are exports encrypted with customer KMS keys and do they include integrity checks (SHA256) and a manifest?

We also attached a short exportability checklist and sample column set we use for ingestion. Looking for concrete runbook steps we can include in our internal audit.

Regards,
Alice Ng
Senior InfoSec Analyst
BigBank
[Attachment: bigbank_export_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Ng <security-review@bigbank.com>
Cc: procurement@bigbank.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP Q: Audit logs, retention & exportability

Hi Alice,

Appreciate the clear checklist. High level answers below; I attached a concise runbook and a small sample export for your ingest team. If you want, we can schedule a short call to walk through the step-by-step.

Summary answers (short):
- Events retained by default: authentication events, model invocation metadata (model id, version, timestamps, token counts), admin console changes, policy/role changes, and system operational events. Default retention window for detailed logs: 90 days. Audit metadata (immutable event index, admin actions) can be retained up to 7 years on request for enterprise contracts.
- Export types: JSONL (line-delimited JSON), CSV, and Parquet. Delivery: S3 presigned PUT (preferred), direct SFTP to an address you provide, or HTTPS POST to an endpoint that accepts multipart uploads.
- One-off export SLA: standard request fulfilled within 48 hours; expedited 24-hour turnaround available under enterprise support with a ticket/PO.
- Encryption & integrity: exports are encrypted at rest. For private deployments we can encrypt using your KMS customer-managed keys. Hosted exports to customer S3 use SSE-C/SSE-KMS as configured. All exports include a signed manifest file with SHA256 checksums and MD5 for backward compatibility.

Attached runbook highlights (see attached PDF):
- Request intake: HubSpot ticket with deal id and export scope
- Authorization: requires sign-off from BigBank security contact + Redwood account owner
- Scope selection: time range, event types, redaction policy (PII suppression rules)
- Staging: snapshot exported to a temporary bucket, checksum manifest generated, then long-term transfer performed to your destination
- Audit: a signed export audit record is added to the Redwood audit trail and included in the package

Attachments: redwood_log_export_runbook_v1.pdf, export_schema_sample.csv, redwood_sys_export_diagram.png

Next steps: If you confirm scope and destination (S3 bucket + IAM role or HTTPS endpoint), we will queue the export and provide a preflight report within 3 business hours.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_log_export_runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 358KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: RFP Q: Audit logs, retention & exportability

Team, forwarding the BigBank checklist and our draft runbook. Need infra confirmation on the following technical items before I finalize:

1) Confirm default 90-day detailed log retention and process to enable the 7-year audit index for an enterprise contract. Is a config flag or a retention policy change sufficient? Estimate cost delta.
2) Confirm export delivery options supported from hosted: presigned S3 PUT (existing), HTTPS POST (experimental), SFTP (legacy). Which are GA? Any IAM role-based push instead of presigned?
3) Confirm we generate SHA256 checksums and a manifest in all export paths. Also confirm the manifest signing mechanism (our internal signing key or customer-provided key).
4) Can we produce CSV with the sample schema in export_schema_sample.csv (attached)? Need column names and timestamp formats (ISO-8601 UTC vs epoch millis).

Proposed internal owner for the job: Aditya for export orchestration; Laura for retention policy/legal sign-off. 

Onwards please. I will mark this urgent for the BigBank procurement timeline.

-----Forwarded attachment: export_schema_sample.csv-----

Best,
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP Q: Audit logs, retention & exportability

Marissa / Laura,

Quick tech confirmation below. Technical runbook notes for the export path we should surface to BigBank:

- Retention: 90 days is the platform default for full detail. The 'audit_index' (immutable pointer table and admin actions) can be retained 7 years by setting the enterprise retention flag on the customer account. This is a metadata-tier copy that increments storage cost roughly +12% on average; I'll produce a cost estimate for BBK.

- Delivery methods: S3 presigned PUT and role-based STS AssumeRole + PutObject are GA. SFTP is supported via our transfer gateway but considered legacy (slower, rate-limited). HTTPS POST (push) is available but rate-limited and recommended only for small exports; not GA for large forensic dumps. We will prioritize S3 presigned or STS role-based transfers for BigBank.

- Checksums & manifest: We always generate a manifest.jsonl with file entries: filename, sha256, bytes, timestamp. The manifest itself is signed using our export signing key (rotated quarterly). If BigBank requires signing with their own key, we can include an additional detached signature that uses customer's PGP key (customer supplies public key during intake).

- Formats & schema: JSONL for raw event exports, Parquet for analytics-ready exports, CSV available for a narrow column set. Timestamp format for CSV exports: ISO-8601 UTC by default (2027-02-16T18:03:00Z). We also include epoch_millis as a supplementary column for ingest flexibility.

- Preflight: Before data movement we run a preflight stage that exports a 24-hour sample to a staging bucket and posts a readiness report with counts, checksums, and estimated full export size. That sample is normally delivered within 3 business hours after scope is confirmed.

I will attach a short cost estimate and the stanza of CLI commands our ops team uses to initiate an export. If BigBank wants STS-based delivery we'll need an IAM role ARN; if presigned PUT we'll need destination bucket plus acceptable prefix.

Aditya
Sr. Infra Engineer

From: Alice Ng <security-review@bigbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bigbank.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP Q: Audit logs, retention & exportability

Marissa,

Thanks for the thorough responses and the runbook. A couple quick clarifications before we move to procurement:

- Confirm export manifest will include sha256 and a signed manifest file. Good to hear about PGP option.
- For CSV schema: can you include both iso_8601 and epoch_millis columns? Confirm column headers match the attached sample exactly.
- SLA: BigBank requires a max 48-hour window for a one-off export for legal purposes. You indicated 48 hours standard; please confirm you will commit to 48 hours for the enterprise contract (BBK-2027-042).
- Delivery: we'll prefer STS AssumeRole delivery. We'll provide a role ARN. Can you provide the minimal IAM permissions we should grant?

If we get these confirmations in writing we will escalate to procurement and share the role details.

Regards,
Alice
Senior InfoSec Analyst
BigBank
